review.shorterRoute: Reuse native separating-coordinate principal divisors, finite place residues, pole/genus dimension maxima, regular-prolongation residue dimensions and global two-chart gluing. The inverse chart is obtained by applying the same coordinate-lifting theorem to the inverse unit, using equality of the rational coordinate fields. No new curve, divisor, Riemann--Roch or Picard interface is introduced.
assumptionsToDischarge: Actual original Gamma1 residue curve geometry is derived from its proved finite separating j.
Coordinate-degree equality and actual adelic-genus equality now imply both integral chart lifts and a degree-preserving place map compatible with every principal divisor.
The literal Gamma1 consumer discharges finite index and translation membership and returns a constant reduction whose regular prolongation is exactly the original coefficient reduction.
review.remaining: Coordinate-degree equality and actual genus equality remain explicit geometric inputs. They, diamond integrality and prime-to-residue Picard torsion injectivity still require proofs. Original Tate Frobenius/inertia, arithmetic realization, all-weight association, automorphy and full higher continuation remain. 16/20; DUB17--20 OPEN.
